author: Shoto_
body:
Basically, there is a tab at the top that says "poll" where users can vote on maps.
Example:

Example by exampleuser
(picture links)
O Yes, add this map
O Yes, but with a few adjustments [enter suggestions here]
O No

Once the user has voted for a map, they can see the results, then vote for another map.
Map creators can view their map's feedback, and the suggestions won't bump the forum post.

"Why should this be added? People can just see the forum topic."
This is an easier way to see the different map suggestions and will be easier for the Map Devs. to see which maps the community enjoys more.
